claim_text: Netanyahu said senior security chiefs chose not to wake him before October 7 because they feared he would order a major alert and thereby trigger an exchange with Hamas; he added that if he had been awakened, the invasion would not have occurred.
discovery_sources: Channel 14 / The Patriots interview; Times of Israel reconstruction; PMO chronology; Channel 12 follow-up reported by Times of Israel 2026-09-04
resolution_notes: Fresh counter-context narrows but does not adjudicate the claim. Channel 12 reports that after Netanyahu was actually awakened by his military secretary at 06:29, he did not phone security chiefs before reaching the Kirya more than two hours later; the PMO chronology places his first full situation assessment at 09:55. Channel 12 also disputes the PMO's transit chronology, citing later possible arrival times. This is relevant to the 'immediately mobilize' assertion but cannot prove or disprove the counterfactual that an overnight wake-up would have prevented the invasion.
